scope: Strategy-only Mastering Mixology timing context. It never selects a herb, recipe, reward, route position, or input batch; it interprets only supplied account state and optional player observations.

observation_conventions.registration_boundary: The shared evaluator does not yet register this optional activity identifier. The standalone analyzer may report a raw supplied observation, but it labels it unregistered rather than validated global account state.
observation_conventions.input_signal: local_supplies is an observed snapshot only. Its keys and counts describe no conversion, reservation, or expendability by themselves.
observation_conventions.potion_opportunity_cost_review: An existing session.last_event value of potion-opportunity-cost-reviewed is a player-reported acknowledgement that ordinary-potion competing uses were reviewed. It does not record the chosen reserve policy or make any herb expendable.
observation_conventions.named_objective: An existing session.mode value of reward:<reward_id>, xp, or enjoyment is a player-reported objective label. Unknown or omitted values mean no objective is inferred.
observation_conventions.resin_balances: Observed balance priority is explicitly supplied resources mixology_mox_resin, mixology_aga_resin, and mixology_lye_resin; optional observation currency rows may corroborate them. Missing values are unknown, not zero.
observation_conventions.confirmed_purchase: confirmed_purchases may record a player-confirmed fixed shop purchase. The analyzer never applies that purchase or manufactures the corresponding item state.

enter_delay_stop_reentry.enter_candidate: Hard access, a player-reported named objective, an observed input signal, and a player-reported potion-opportunity-cost review are all present. This is an enter candidate, not a route command or output forecast.
delay_conditions: No player-observed input signal is available.
Ordinary-potion opportunity cost has not been player-reviewed.
No player-reported reward, XP, or enjoyment objective is present.
stop_conditions: The player-reported target is confirmed purchased or no longer current.
The player-reported input allocation or reserve policy changes.
The active session is ended or interrupted.
reentry_conditions: A new player-reported objective, current input observation, and potion-opportunity-cost review are available.

herb_sack_boundary: The existing durable Herb sack model owns standard Herb sack timing and acquisition. Silklined Herb sack needs a separately observed Sarachnis silk upgrade and is not a Mixology reward target.
